commands.review_summary:
The PR changes package metadata, API contracts, archive finder/import tests, backup Git setup, LaunchAgent plist generation, profile hydration, and xurl transport code to add portability hardening and optional bearer-token reads.

Reproducibility: yes. from source inspection: set a bearer-token env var in a setup that also has xurl OAuth available, and the PR head returns `availableTransport: "bearer"` while authored sync and live data-source status still require `xurl`. I did not run a live X setup in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] Manual review is needed because contributor proof is mock-only and maintainers need to choose the bearer status and backup upgrade behavior before merge.

target.title: fix: isolate backup Git repositories
target.body:
## Summary

- Keep backup commits rooted in the configured repository even when that path sits inside another Git worktree.
- Generate a marked `.gitattributes` block at the end of the backup file, preserving user rules while making LF the effective line ending for hash-checked JSONL and manifest files.
- Fetch `origin/main` into its remote-tracking ref before the initial checkout.
- Document the backup layout and add the user-visible fix to the changelog.

## Scope decision

Maintainer review narrowed the original 15-file proposal to the cohesive backup-integrity fix. The archive/LaunchAgent separator changes did not establish a supported Windows runtime path, the test-only zip dependency was unnecessary, and direct bearer transport needs a separate auth/status contract rather than sharing this PR. No dependency was added.

## Validation

- `node ./scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/lib/backup.test.ts` (18 tests)
- `pnpm test` (141 files, 1182 tests)
- `pnpm run check`
- `pnpm build`
- Autoreview found one `.gitattributes` precedence edge; fixed with an end-anchored marked block and `git check-attr` regression. Final autoreview: no actionable findings.

## Built CLI proof

- Exported and committed a fresh isolated backup at a configured path inside an enclosing Git repository.
- The backup path was its own Git toplevel; the enclosing repository index stayed clean.
- `git check-attr` reported `eol: lf` for both a JSONL shard and `manifest.json`.
- Built CLI validation passed for all 11 shards with zero errors; the backup commit tracked 14 files including `.gitattributes`.
